language.name: Primmel
language.specification: MN 114, the Primmel Language Specification (v3.1 draft, 2026-08-28); the v3.1 clauses (DAT-01 to DAT-04) anchor to its clause 19, and the v3 clauses' identifiers re-key to the specification's conformance clauses when it publishes.

areas.syntax: The document grammar: structure, identifiers, and the five entity kinds (requirement, conformance test, form, calculation, table).
areas.serialization: The codec rules: the re-serialization fixed point and the canonical emission form.
areas.checks: The constraint machinery: the rule-identified checks a conforming checker applies to a package.
areas.packaging: The package layer: the manifest, editions, version pins, layered composition, and abstract imports.
areas.errors: The named error cases: structural parse errors, enumerated facet rejection, and the duplicate-identifier issue.
areas.dataspace: The v3.1 extension set (MN 114 clause 19): the dataspace construct, the policy construct, the trust reference, and the correspondence annotations.

layout.clauses.json: the clause map: one conformance rule per clause, with its area and check-rule identifiers
layout.corpus/cases.json: the case index: every case with its clause, polarity, kind, path, and expectation
layout.corpus/syntax/: single-document cases for the syntax clauses
layout.corpus/checks/: single-package directories for the check clauses
layout.corpus/packaging/: package directories (some multi-package composition scenarios) for the packaging clauses
layout.runner/run.mts: the runner: executes an adapter against the corpus and reports clause by clause
layout.runner/reference-adapter.mts: the reference adapter: the primmel-ts implementation of the adapter contract
layout.docs/running-a-third-party-implementatio: the adapter contract and the conformance-claim rules
